entities.blurb: A guster banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with the appearance of a breeze. It can only be found in trial chambers and cannot be crafted.

entities.blurb: A guster pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a breeze. It can be found in trial chambers.

entities.name: Happy Ghast Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A heart of the sea is an item found only in buried treasure chests. It, alongside nautilus shells, is required to craft a conduit.
entities.name: Heart of the Sea

entities.blurb: A heart pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a heart. It can be found in trail ruins.
entities.name: Heart Pottery Sherd

entities.blurb: A heartbreak pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a broken heart. It can be found in trail ruins.
entities.name: Heartbreak Pottery Sherd

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Hoglin Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: A honey bottle is a consumable drink item obtainable by using a glass bottle on a full beehive or bee nest. Honey bottles remove Poison when consumed and can be used to craft honey blocks and sugar.
entities.name: Honey Bottle

entities.blurb: Honeycombs are items obtained by shearing full bee nests and beehives. They are used to craft beehives, candles, and honeycomb blocks. It can also be applied as wax to many copper blocks to prevent them from oxidizing over time, as well as to signs to prevent them from being edited.
entities.name: Honeycomb

entities.blurb: A minecart with hopper is a minecart with a hopper inside. Unlike a normal hopper, it pulls items from containers much more quickly, cannot push items into containers, can collect item entities through a single layer of solid blocks, and is locked and unlocked via activator rails.
entities.name: Minecart with Hopper

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Horse Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: Host armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, terracotta, and seven diamonds.
entities.name: Host Armor Trim Smithing Template

entities.blurb: A howl pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a wolf. It can be found in trail ruins.
entities.name: Howl Pottery Sherd

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Husk Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: An ink sac is an item dropped by a squid upon death. It can be used to craft black dye, dark prismarine,‌[BE  only] and books and quills.
entities.name: Ink Sac

entities.blurb: An iron axe is a variant of axe and can be crafted from iron ingots. It can be used to cut down trees faster, to strip logs and scrape copper-based blocks, and as a melee weapon that disables shields. It is the third-highest tier of axe, having higher mining efficiency, attack speed, durability, and enchantability than a copper axe.
entities.name: Iron Axe

entities.blurb: Iron boots are a variant of boots that are crafted from iron ingots. They are the third-highest tier of boots, having higher armor points than leather, golden, copper, and chainmail boots.
entities.name: Iron Boots

entities.blurb: An iron chestplate is a variant of chestplate that is crafted from iron ingots. It is the third-highest tier of chestplate, having higher armor points than golden and chainmail chestplates.
entities.name: Iron Chestplate

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.
entities.name: Iron Golem Spawn Egg

entities.blurb: An iron helmet is a variant of helmet that is crafted from iron ingots. It is the fifth-highest tier of helmet, having the same armor points as a copper helmet but with higher durability.
entities.name: Iron Helmet

entities.blurb: An iron hoe is a variant of hoe that is crafted from iron ingots. It is used to till dirt-related blocks into farmland, and to break leaves, haybales, and sculk-related blocks faster. It is the third-highest tier of hoe, having higher mining efficiency, attack speed, durability, and enchantability than a copper hoe.
entities.name: Iron Hoe

entities.blurb: Iron horse armor is the fourth-strongest tier of horse armor. Unlike other iron items, it cannot be crafted and is only obtainable from chest loot in various structures.
entities.name: Iron Horse Armor

entities.blurb: An iron ingot is a metal ingot smelted from raw iron and is used to craft many items and tools.
entities.name: Iron Ingot

entities.blurb: Iron leggings are a variant of leggings that are crafted from iron ingots. They are the third-highest tier of leggings, having higher armor points than chainmail leggings.
entities.name: Iron Leggings

entities.blurb: Iron nautilus armor is a type of nautilus armor that can be equipped by a nautilus that reduces the damage received to the nautilus. It is the fourth-strongest tier of nautilus armor, having higher armor points than copper nautilus armor.
entities.name: Iron Nautilus Armor

entities.blurb: Iron nuggets are small pieces of iron that are used to craft various items such as iron ingots.  They can be obtained by smelting iron tools, iron weapons, or iron and chainmail armor. One iron nugget is effectively worth one-ninth of an iron ingot.
entities.name: Iron Nugget

entities.blurb: An iron pickaxe is a variant of pickaxe that is crafted from iron ingots. It is the third-highest tier of pickaxe, having higher mining efficiency, durability, attack damage, and enchantability than a copper pickaxe. It has a mining level of 2, allowing it to mine gold ore, redstone ore, emerald ore, and diamond ore.
entities.name: Iron Pickaxe

entities.blurb: An iron shovel is a variant of shovel that is crafted from iron ingots. It is used to break dirt, sand, gravel and other related blocks faster, to create dirt paths from dirt-related blocks, and to extinguish campfires. It is the third-highest tier of shovel, having higher mining efficiency, attack damage, durability, and enchantability than a copper shovel.
entities.name: Iron Shovel

entities.blurb: An iron spear is a variant of spear crafted from iron ingots. It can be used to perform slow jab attacks or held forward to deal increasing damage based on how quickly the wielder is moving. It is the third-highest tier of spear, dealing more damage and having higher durability than a stone spear, at the cost of lower attack speed.
entities.name: Iron Spear

entities.blurb: An iron sword is a variant of sword crafted from iron ingots. It is the third-highest tier of sword, dealing more damage and having more durability than stone and copper swords.
entities.name: Iron Sword

entities.blurb: An item frame is an entity‌[JE  only] or block‌[BE  only] that displays the item or block that is inside of it.
entities.name: Item Frame

entities.blurb: Boats (including bamboo rafts) are drivable vehicle entities that can be ridden through water or at high speeds across all types of ice. Most mobs board nearby boats, which they cannot control or exit on their own.
entities.name: Jungle Boat

entities.blurb: Boats with chests (including bamboo rafts with chests) are boats with single chests occupying their passenger seats. A boat's chest can be accessed by using the boat while sneaking, or while riding it.
entities.name: Jungle Boat with Chest

entities.blurb: A knowledge book is a utility item that reveals available crafting recipes to the player when used.
entities.name: Knowledge Book

entities.blurb: Lapis lazuli is a mineral required to enchant items in an enchanting table. It is also a source of blue dye.
entities.name: Lapis Lazuli

entities.blurb: A lava bucket is a bucket filled with lava, which is the only way to carry it as an item. It can be used as fuel, smelting 100 items.
entities.name: Lava Bucket

entities.blurb: Leads are utility items used to leash and lead certain entities. Leashed entities can be tied to fences or other entities by using the fence or entity while sneaking. A lead can be removed from an entity by shearing it.
entities.name: Lead

entities.blurb: Leather is an item used to craft bundles, books, saddles, armor, and other items.
entities.name: Leather

entities.blurb: Leather boots are a variant of boots that are crafted from leather. They are the seventh-highest tier of boots, having the same armor points as golden, copper, and chainmail boots but with lower durability. Wearing them allows an entity to walk on and climb through powder snow. Like all leather armor, they can be dyed and protect the wearer from freezing.
entities.name: Leather Boots

entities.blurb: A leather cap is a variant of helmet that is crafted from leather. It is the eighth-highest tier of helmet, having the lowest armor points and durability. Like all leather armor, it can be dyed and protects the wearer from freezing.

entities.blurb: A netherite axe is a late-game variant of axe obtained by upgrading a diamond axe using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. It can be used to cut down trees faster, to strip logs and scrape copper-based blocks, and as a melee weapon that disables shields. It is the highest tier of axe, having higher mining efficiency, attack damage, durability, and enchantability than a diamond axe.

entities.blurb: Netherite boots are a late-game variant of boots obtained by upgrading diamond boots using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. They are the highest tier of boots, having higher armor toughness, durability, and enchantability than diamond boots. Like all netherite armor, netherite boots provide 10% knockback resistance when worn, are immune to burning from fire and lava in item form, and take no durability damage from lava when worn.
entities.name: Netherite Boots

entities.blurb: A netherite chestplate is a late-game variant of chestplate obtained by upgrading a diamond chestplate using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. Like all netherite armor, a netherite chestplate provides 10% knockback resistance when worn, is immune to burning from fire and lava in item form, and takes no durability damage from lava when worn.
entities.name: Netherite Chestplate

entities.blurb: A netherite helmet is a late-game variant of helmet obtained by upgrading a diamond helmet using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. It is the highest tier of helmet, having higher armor toughness, durability, and enchantability than a diamond helmet. Like all netherite armor, a netherite helmet provides 10% knockback resistance when worn, is immune to burning from fire and lava in item form, and takes no durability damage from lava, fire, or magma damage when worn.

entities.blurb: Boats with chests (including bamboo rafts with chests) are boats with single chests occupying their passenger seats. A boat's chest can be accessed by using the boat while sneaking, or while riding it.
entities.name: Oak Boat with Chest

entities.blurb: A spawn egg is an item used to instantly spawn mobs.

entities.blurb: An ominous bottle is an item that gives a player the Bad Omen effect for 100 minutes when drank, which can cause an ominous event (raid) to start when the player arrives in a fully populated village while under the effect of the potion.

entities.blurb: An ominous trial key is a type of trial key that can only be obtained from ominous trial spawners. It is used to unlock an ominous vault and obtain its loot.
entities.name: Ominous Trial Key
